name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2025-06-02, at wavelengths from 1.32 to 4.30 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
